name: InjectionSiteRotation
summary: Track subcutaneous injection sites and suggest the next one to rotate to.
description: A tiny Swift library for apps that log weekly or daily injections (insulin pens, GLP-1 pens and similar): six body sites (abdomen, thighs, upper arms, left and right), least-recently-used rotation with area/side tie-breaking, and days since each site was used. Logging and rotation only; it never recommends or calculates doses.
